title: Thai Vegan Chicken Noodle Soup
description: A delicious and comforting vegan soup inspired by Thai flavors. A perfect meal for a chilly day.
instructions: Combine vegetable broth, red curry paste, and vegan chicken seasoning in a large pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and let simmer for 10 minutes.
Add sliced mushrooms and marinated tofu to the pot and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add mixed bell peppers and cook until tender.
Cook rice noodles according to package instructions.
Combine cooked noodles, soup mixture, and coconut cream in a large bowl.
Stir to combine and serve hot.
Garnish with additional mixed bell peppers if desired.
